entry.name: message
entry.description: message displays and sends any given message with the capability to handle specified arguments.

arguments.name: message
arguments.description: The initial contents of thebox are typed in when the patcher window is unlocked. Any message can be contained in abox. Certain characters have special meaning.

arguments.name: changeable-arg
arguments.description: A dollar sign (), followed immediately by a number in the range 1-9, is a changeable argument. This argument's value can be replaced by the corresponding item in a list received in the inlet. (Example:stores the second item in a list as its value before sending out the contents of thebox .) The value of a changeable argument is initially.

arguments.name: comma
arguments.digest: Divide a message into separate messages
arguments.description: A comma () divides a message into separate messages which will be sent out in order. (Example:sends out, then, then.)

arguments.name: backslash
arguments.description: A backslash () is used to negate (escape) the traits of a special character. When a backslash immediately precedes a dollar sign, comma, or semicolon, the character is treated as a normal character. (Example:.)

messages.name: (mouse)
messages.description: A mouse click on abox sends its contents out the object's outlet.

messages.name: append
messages.digest: Add text at end of current message
messages.description: The wordfollowed by any message will set thebox to display that message after any text which it already contains without triggering output.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: In left inlet: Sends out the contents of thebox. A mouse click on thebox has the same effect.In right inlet: Sets the contents of thebox to 'bang' without triggering output.

messages.name: float
messages.description: In left inlet: The number replaces the value stored in the argument, if such an argument exists, then sends out the contents of thebox.In right inlet: Sets the contents of thebox without triggering output.

messages.name: int
messages.description: In left inlet: The number replaces the value stored in the argument, if such an argument exists, then sends out the contents of thebox.In right inlet: Sets the contents of thebox without triggering output.

messages.name: list
messages.description: Each item in the list replaces the value of its correspondingargument, if such an argument exists, then sends out the contents of thebox.In right inlet: Sets the contents of thebox without triggering output.

messages.name: prepend
messages.digest: Add text in front of current contents
messages.description: The wordfollowed by any message will set thebox to display that message before any text which it already contains without triggering output.

messages.name: set
messages.description: The word, followed by a message, sets the contents of thebox to that new message, without triggering output. The wordby itself clears the contents of thebox .

messages.name: setargs
messages.digest: Sets changeable argument(s) in a message box
messages.description: The word, followed by a message, sets the changeable argument(s) (e.g. $1) of the receivingbox, without triggering output.

messages.name: symbol
messages.description: In left inlet: The symbol replaces the value stored in the argument, if such an argument exists, then sends out the contents of thebox.In right inlet: Sets the contents of thebox without triggering output.
